name: android_input_text
description: Enters text in the focused field, or in element elementId from the UI tree. method "paste" (default) pastes the exact text through the device clipboard, replacing it, so IMEs such as Telex cannot alter it; where adb cannot set the clipboard (no `cmd clipboard`, as on the Android 10 and 13 devices tested) ASCII is typed instead and other text fails, and the result says which. method "type" sends key events, ASCII only, and keeps the clipboard. An empty text clears the field.

text.description: Text to enter; empty to clear the field.

method.description: paste (default, any text) or type (ASCII only).

elementId.description: Element [#ID] from android_get_ui_tree to focus first.

clearFirst.description: Clear the existing text first (default false).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
